product.name: Zimbexa
product.primary_platform: Android-first mobile client, deferred until the backend phase is complete
product.backend_phase: Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL, PostgREST RPC, and private Supabase Storage

document_status: Engineering baseline translated into a backend-first Supabase implementation. Not approved for production launch.

decisions_confirmed_by_product_owner.initial_scope_target: Full V1 backend target, delivered in dependency-ordered stages.
decisions_confirmed_by_product_owner.backend_platform: Connected Supabase; migrations and tests are built in this repository.
decisions_confirmed_by_product_owner.cloud_changes: Do not restore, create, or modify a remote Supabase project during this work.
decisions_confirmed_by_product_owner.release_intent: Production is the intended destination, but production readiness must not be claimed until all gates pass.
decisions_confirmed_by_product_owner.governance_handling: Use safe defaults and keep legally/product-sensitive operations gated pending sign-off.

problem: Ugandan construction teams need a durable, project-scoped record of site progress, materials, costs, advances and evidence that does not disappear when a contributor leaves. Human-reported activity must remain distinguishable from approvals and independently verified events.
product_promise: Preserve project history and make work, stock and money understandable without presenting unverified reports as facts independently confirmed by Zimbexa.

personas.name: Property owner / project custodian
needs: Review progress, spending and key records
Retain project continuity and exports according to approved policy

personas.name: Contractor / project manager
needs: Manage operational activity within delegated scope

personas.name: Supervisor / storekeeper
needs: Capture reports, labor activity, deliveries, issues and stock movements quickly
Work with intermittent connectivity in the future mobile client

personas.name: Accountant / designated approver
needs: Review costs, budgets, cash advances and reported payments
See finance only where project permissions allow

personas.name: Viewer / engineer
needs: Review only the project records granted to their membership

goals: Build one useful backend vertical workflow at a time, with database enforcement and tests.
Keep user identity separate from workspace, project custody and authored records.
Prevent cross-project reads and writes through UUID guessing.
Ensure retries do not duplicate stock, cost or cash events.
Keep inventory, cost, cash advance, return and reported payment ledgers separate and traceable.
Keep the backend usable if marketplace, payments, subscriptions and AI are never delivered.
non_goals: Native Android or iOS screens in this backend phase.
Supplier or professional-services marketplace, checkout, logistics or purchase orders.
Zimbexa payment collection, MoMo payout, payment initiation or automatic provider confirmation.
AI report authoring, forecasts, approvals or autonomous decisions.
Legal adjudication of land title, ownership or contested project custody.

site_operations: Daily report drafts, revisions and review
materials: Project material specifications and explicit units
finance: Cost drafts, review and correction events
Cash advances, separate issuance approval, allocations and returns
labor: Dated labor entries, review and correction revisions
Separate approved wage-cost linkage and restricted pay visibility

data_and_security_invariants: All primary identifiers are UUIDs; timestamps are timestamptz.
Project authorization is checked from current authenticated membership at transaction time.
No authenticated role receives direct business-table writes; mutations go through granted RPCs.
Approved costs and submitted evidence are not silently overwritten; corrections create new events or revisions.
Stock balance equals the committed movement ledger and cannot become negative through a valid RPC.
An advance is not a project cost; allocated approved cost and returned cash reduce unaccounted advance separately.
A manually entered bank or mobile-money reference remains user-reported until a separate reconciliation process verifies it.
Private evidence remains unreadable until an authorized scan worker marks it clean.
Removing a project member revokes future access without deleting their authored history.
No project becomes active, transferred, finally completed, exported, purged or account-deleted through an unsigned policy path.

release_gates.reason: Custody and independent recovery policy requires approval.
Operational handover and legal custody are distinct; transfer policy is unresolved.
Contested authority must not be automatically assigned.
Retention and shared-record deletion rules require approval.
Final completion and outstanding exceptions need an agreed policy.
Scope, post-membership rights and redaction policy require approval.
Support access must be separately governed and audited.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: No unauthorized cross-project reads or writes, including search, Storage and exports.
non_functional_requirements.measurement: RLS probes and negative authorization tests for each role.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Retried logical writes have at most one business effect.
non_functional_requirements.measurement: Operation UUID replay and collision tests.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Concurrent stock issues cannot produce a negative committed balance.
non_functional_requirements.measurement: Two-connection contention test against target Supabase/Postgres is required before pilot.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Sensitive personal, financial, labor and evidence data has scoped access and an approved retention basis.
non_functional_requirements.measurement: Uganda privacy review and data-handling inventory; not yet completed.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Backups can be restored with project IDs, attachments, ledgers and audit history preserved.
non_functional_requirements.measurement: Documented, observed restore test required; not yet performed.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Future client must show local-only, sending, synced, rejected and conflict states honestly.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: An outsider cannot read another project's records, finance or files by guessing UUIDs.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: PGlite RLS/read-isolation coverage; live Supabase probes still required.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: A recovery claimant cannot self-assign custody; all outcomes leave a durable review trail.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: Case model and closed adjudication gate; live recovery review is not approved.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: Opposing transfers cannot bypass the recorded governance version and independent approval.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: Version-bound proposal flow and closed transfer gate.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: A removed member cannot commit queued work after access revocation.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: Current-membership checks in write RPCs; full offline client test deferred.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: Concurrent stock issues never commit a negative balance.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: Transactional locking and sequential overdraw test; two-session test remains required.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: A stock receipt retried after timeout appears once in the ledger.
An approved cost cannot be silently edited; an amendment is reviewed separately.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: Revision and adjustment RPCs implemented; PGlite approval path tested.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: UGX 500,000 advance less UGX 320,000 justified and UGX 80,000 returned leaves UGX 100,000 unaccounted.
Account deletion request does not cascade-delete legitimate project history.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: Request-only workflow tested; actual retention/deletion execution gated and not implemented.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: A project cannot become completed without an approved closeout and required acknowledgement.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: Closeout request/review model implemented; final completion gate is closed and tested.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: A normal upgrade preserves project IDs, media references and audit history.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: Additive initial migrations; populated old-version migration test remains required.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: A production-like backup restores into an isolated environment with verifiable totals.
A forwarded invitation cannot be accepted by a different verified identity.
A stale revision returns a conflict without overwriting the server state.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: PGlite stale report revision test passes.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: Exports are scoped to agreed rights and never disclose unrelated project records.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: Export request gate is closed pending policy approval.

acceptance_scenarios.requirement: General project viewers cannot see private worker pay details.
acceptance_scenarios.implementation_status: RLS policy separates finance/pay visibility; dedicated live Supabase test remains required.
